description: Stack Overflow questions matching words, optionally by tags and accepted status: title, score, answer count, accepted flag, tags and link. With answers=1 the accepted answer's first 600 characters are included. Content is CC BY-SA 4.0 (attribution per item). Stack Exchange API 2.3. Price: $0.001 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

accepted.description: true to keep only questions with an accepted answer

answers.description: 1 to include the accepted answer's text

tagged.description: Tags separated by commas, e.g. rust,tokio
